headline: Across media, gaming, publishing and education, firms report mixed performance with cost cuts, AI pilots and uneven IT spending.
summary: Media giants see revenue growth but tighten IT budgets amid cost‑saving drives. Gaming firms show strong top‑line gains but divergent margins and mixed IT outlooks. Publishing players balance AI investments with modest revenue moves. Education entities display varied sentiment, from Pearson’s growth to SLU’s staffing cuts.

industries.summary: Disney posted 8% revenue growth and a 43% jump in operating income but is tightening IT spend. WBD/Skydance and Versant report modest revenue gains and digital rebuilds. Private players Cox and LA Times show neutral or unclear signals.

leaders.why: largest Q3 revenue at $25,947 m and strong operating margin

laggards.why: no revenue data and unclear IT outlook
